webhooks.detail: Webhook subscriptions via POST /developer/v1/webhooks; signed (X-Ramp-Signature), verification challenge, event types per resource (bills, transactions, etc.), mock-event endpoint

evidence.quote: Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications about events that occur in your Ramp account.

sandbox.detail: Sandbox exists (demo.ramp.com UI, demo-api.ramp.com API) but access must be requested via a form; free status not stated in docs.

evidence.quote: Need a test environment for development?

rate_limits.summary: 200 requests / 10 s per source IP; token endpoint 100 POST / 10 s per IP; 429 and 60 s block

evidence.quote: The standard Developer API limit is 200 requests per 10 seconds per source IP address.
